masstige_gap_note: The observed India ladder is barbelled. Mass sits at Rs500-700 (India D2C serum), and imported K-beauty premium sits at Rs2000-2999 (Anua toner, large-format Innisfree). Between them, the Rs700-1600 masstige band is populated almost entirely by K-beauty SKUs that reach it only through heavy promotion — COSRX essence lists at Rs1490 MRP but sells at Rs969; Innisfree's small serum lands at Rs680 on Blinkit; The Face Show/Laneige/Etude q-commerce SKUs sit Rs600-1600. This is precisely the corridor's opening: mid-price derma K-beauty at a genuine (not promo-dependent) Rs700-1500 shelf price on the q-commerce rail into Tier 2/3 (baseline whitespace #5). The MRP-vs-promoted spread is the tell — brands are papering the masstige gap with discounts on premium-listed SKUs rather than pricing a true masstige tier, which an entrant with lower landed cost (e.g. India-manufactured Korean-ingredient line) could occupy directly.
